description:
## Features

### YouTube
- **Built-in downloader, subtitles:** The download picker has an `Include subtitles` switch. Pick up to five caption tracks, including auto-translated ones, and a format (SRT by default, or VTT). The files are saved to `Movies/RVX/Subtitles`, and the built-in player shows them with a CC menu for track, size, colour, background and position. Videos without captions show `No subtitles to download`. Your choices are remembered, and deleting a download deletes its subtitle files.
  - A subtitle problem never fails the video download.
  - Auto-translated subtitles first prepare a visitor session and can take about a minute. YouTube sometimes limits them (HTTP 429); the download then keeps the video and the subtitles already saved, and names the language that was skipped.
  - Subtitles are not embedded into the video file in this release. They play in the built-in player; YouTube's own player keeps its own captions.

## Bug Fixes

### YouTube
- **Built-in downloader:** In the offline library the expanded search pill now reaches the overflow menu, and the back arrow and overflow icon keep the same colour as the title while searching.
- **Shorts custom actions:** The download row reads `Download` instead of `External downloader` when the built-in downloader is on, in the Shorts menu, the queue manager and the player button's accessibility label.

## Compatibility
- YouTube: **21.39.525, 21.13.164, 20.05.46**.
- YouTube Music: **9.40.51, 9.15.51, 8.30.54**.

[Full changelog](https://github.com/lavinhoque33/revanced-patches/compare/v1.25.0...v1.26.0)
